decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits close to the core offer and has its own web page, so it likely meets aspirations, and a growing, investing firm has the slack to keep it after pruning the weaker modules.

Equipment monitoring uses the installed base and fits the move toward lifecycle services, but it is only mentioned on the website and its sister apron modules were dropped, so it carries some risk of further consolidation.
The controller safety alert service builds on tower and surveillance expertise and serves core safety goals, so without a clear shortfall the firm keeps carrying it while results remain uncertain.
